/////////////////////////
// machinesraw_normalized
/////////////////////////
.create-merge table machinesraw_normalized (
    machine_id: string,
    machine_type: string,
    timestamp: datetime,
    state: string,
    attribute_name: string,
    attribute_value_decimal: real
)

.create-or-alter function with (
    folder = "Normalization",
    docstring = "Normalize machinesraw payload into one row per numeric attribute, excluding anomaly"
)
machinesraw_normalized_fn()
{
    machinesraw
    | project-away EventProcessedUtcTime, EventEnqueuedUtcTime, PartitionId
    | extend pj = parse_json(payload)
    | extend attribute_name = bag_keys(pj)
    | mv-expand attribute_name to typeof(string)
    | where attribute_name != "anomaly"
    | extend raw_value = pj[attribute_name]
    | extend attribute_value_decimal = toreal(tostring(raw_value))
    | extend timestamp = todatetime(timestamp)
    | project machine_id, machine_type, timestamp, state, attribute_name, attribute_value_decimal
}

.alter table machinesraw_normalized policy update
@'[{"IsEnabled": true,"Source": "machinesraw","Query": "machinesraw_normalized_fn()","IsTransactional": false,"PropagateIngestionProperties": true}]'


.set-or-append machinesraw_normalized <|
machinesraw_normalized_fn()

// .delete table machinesraw_normalized policy update

// .drop table machinesraw_normalized

/////////////////////////
// machinesraw_temperature
/////////////////////////

.create-merge table machinesraw_temperature (
    machine_id: string,
    machine_type: string,
    timestamp: datetime,
    state: string,
    temperature: real
)

.create-or-alter function with (
    folder = "Normalization",
    docstring = "Extract only temperature from machinesraw payload"
)
machinesraw_temperature_fn()
{
    machinesraw
    | project-away EventProcessedUtcTime, EventEnqueuedUtcTime, PartitionId
    | extend pj = parse_json(payload)
    | extend temperature = toreal(tostring(pj.temperature))
    | where isnotnull(temperature)
    | extend timestamp = todatetime(timestamp)
    | project machine_id, machine_type, timestamp, state, temperature
}

.alter table machinesraw_temperature policy update
@'[{"IsEnabled": true, "Source": "machinesraw", "Query": "machinesraw_temperature_fn()", "IsTransactional": false, "PropagateIngestionProperties": true}]'

.set-or-append machinesraw_temperature <|
machinesraw_temperature_fn()

// .delete table machinesraw_temperature policy update

// .drop table machinesraw_temperature

tabs.content:
machinesraw_normalized
| summarize arg_max(timestamp, *) by machine_id, attribute_name
| join kind=inner external_table('machineparameters') on $left.machine_id==$right.machine_id and $left.attribute_name==$right.attribute_name
| extend anomaly = iff(attribute_value_decimal >= min_value and attribute_value_decimal <= max_value, false, true)
| where anomaly == true
| project machine_id, attribute_name, timestamp, attribute_value_decimal, anomaly, max_value, min_value
